claims.claim_text: Sales to the U.S. government were $33,279M in 2025 (38% of total net sales), and foreign military sales through the U.S. government were $6,702M (8%).
claims.subject: RTX Corporation
claims.source_quote: Sales to the U.S. government (1) $ 33,279 ... Foreign military sales through the U.S. government 6,702 ... 38 % 8 %

queries.rationale: Confirm RTX is a major federal contract recipient at the scale claimed.
Cross-check obligated federal $$ vs disclosed $33.3B U.S. gov revenue + $107B defense backlog; large gap is SEVE.

claims.claim_text: Raytheon booked $2.5 billion on contracts to provide Guidance Enhanced Missiles (GEM-T) and Patriot launchers for international customers and the U.S. Army in 2025.
claims.subject: Raytheon segment
claims.source_quote: Raytheon booked $2.5 billion on several contracts to provide Guidance Enhanced Missiles (GEM-T) and Patriot launchers for international customers and the U.S. Army

queries.rationale: Confirm DoD Patriot / GEM-T contracts awarded to Raytheon.
Confirm Patriot program forward-funded in most recent two PB releases; a wound-down line would contradict the $2.5B booking.

claims.claim_text: Raytheon booked $2.1B for AMRAAM and $1.5B for LRIP of LTAMDS for U.S. Army and Poland in 2025.
claims.subject: Raytheon segment
claims.source_quote: $2.1 billion to provide AMRAAM to the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Navy, and international customers, ... $1.5 billion for low-rate initial production (LRIP) of LTAMDS for the U.S. Army and Poland

queries.rationale: Confirm AMRAAM obligations to Raytheon.
Confirm LTAMDS funded in most recent PB; LRIP is a transition phase where program could be cut.

claims.claim_text: Pratt & Whitney booked $2.9B for F135 production and $2.4B for F135 sustainment in 2025; military sales increased due to higher production volume on the F135 program and F135 Engine Core Upgrade (ECU).
claims.subject: Pratt & Whitney
claims.source_quote: Pratt & Whitney booked $2.9 billion for F135 production and $2.4 billion for F135 sustainment

queries.rationale: Confirm DoD F135 obligations to Pratt.
Check F135/ECU funding posture in latest two PB releases; F-35 propulsion has had recurring competition / NGAP threats.

claims.claim_text: Raytheon had customer-funded development spending related to the Next Generation Interceptor (NGI) program; in 2024 spending decreased on NGI.
claims.subject: Raytheon segment
claims.source_quote: lower spending on customer-funded expenses at Raytheon on military development programs, specifically related to the Next Generation Interceptor (NGI) program

queries.rationale: Confirm Raytheon as NGI contractor (vs Lockheed which won down-select).
NGI down-select winner was selected in FY24 (Lockheed). Check whether Raytheon line is zeroed in PB26.

claims.claim_text: Total backlog (RPO) was approximately $268B at Dec 31 2025 (defense $107B; commercial $161B); 2025 defense bookings were $61B.
claims.subject: RTX Corporation
claims.source_quote: Total backlog was approximately $268 billion ... defense backlog of $107 billion and $93 billion as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 ... Defense bookings were approximately $61 billion in both 2025 and 2024

queries.rationale: Confirm 10-K filing exists and disclosure is on file.
Cross-check federal obligations against $107B defense backlog; large divergence is SEVE.

claims.subject: Pratt & Whitney
claims.object_value: Pratt supplies F135 to Lockheed-prime F-35
claims.source_quote: $2.9 billion for F135 production ... higher production volume on the F135 program

queries.rationale: Mode A: confirm Pratt & Whitney is identified as a supplier in Lockheed Martin filings.
Mode B: cross-disclosure check. Lockheed (CIK 936468) MUST mention F135 propulsion. Zero hits would be SEVE.

claims.claim_text: Pratt & Whitney faces three DCMA CAS noncompliance claims totaling $1.7B + $1.1B + a prior claim ($209M interest), and the Powder Metal Matter resulted in a $2.9B pre-tax charge in Q3 2023; expects elevated AOG levels through 2026.
claims.subject: Pratt & Whitney
claims.source_quote: DCMA DACO ... asserted a claim against Pratt & Whitney to recover alleged overpayments of approximately $1.7 billion plus interest ($1.5 billion at December 31, 2025) ... a second claim ... payment of $1.1 billion plus interest ($410 million at December 31, 2025)

queries.rationale: Confirm RTX files 10-K with these disclosures.
Insider Form 4 timing around Powder Metal disclosure / DCMA claims is a red flag for discretionary sales.
